content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near the O2 arena in London set off a fire that destroyed a van, damaged a car and a lorry, and prompted the London fire brigade to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown shortly before 8 p.m. on Saturday. About twenty‑five firefighters brought the blaze under control in just over an hour, with no injuries reported. The fire followed a pre‑planned filming event at the site, which is close to the venue that will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas next week. The brigade posted on X that the fire is now under control, noting the van was destroyed and most of the car and lorry were damaged, and that there are no injury reports. They added that the fire originated from a controlled explosion that spread, and crews will stay on scene for the rest of the evening. The yard is also near London’s cable car link across the River Thames, and a Metropolitan Police spokesperson said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
